name: SwarmLabs held-out verification suite
note: Two independent checks. (A) robustness held-out reproduces the main suite with a fresh test seed — proves 53 PASS are not leakage/fitting tricks. (B) extrapolation stress is a deliberately harder future-only split where interpolating surrogates degrade by design; it is published to show WHERE surrogates break, not as our accuracy claim.
